title: Foundation Plan
description: The working sketch/0.19 JSON import and export representation for one First Draft Project graph.

format.title: Format
format.description: Names the Foundation Plan serialization vocabulary and its version.

subjectUuid.title: Subject UUID
subjectUuid.description: A stable Project-scoped UUIDv7 for one independently mutable document subject.

scopedPath.title: Readable scoped path
scopedPath.description: A typed, readable path built from owner-local keys and resolved within the property namespace.

localKey.title: Local key
localKey.description: A lower-snake-case readable key local to the object that owns it.

displayName.title: Display name
displayName.description: The human-facing name shown to reviewers, even when it matches humanized key text. It must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

nonblankString.title: Nonblank string
nonblankString.description: A string containing at least one code point outside the Unicode White_Space set.

nonnegativeCount.title: Nonnegative count
nonnegativeCount.description: A whole-number count within JSON's exactly interoperable integer range.

positiveCount.title: Positive count
positiveCount.description: A positive whole-number count within JSON's exactly interoperable integer range.

target.title: Target
target.description: Selects the platform and versioned target profile that interpret this Plan.

id.title: Target ID
id.description: Names the output platform. The working examples currently exercise only Rails.

profile.title: Target profile
profile.description: Pins the release of target defaults, supported lowerings, and verification expectations.

application.title: Application
application.description: The semantic application definition and sparse target choices for this Plan.

key.title: Application key
key.description: The lower-snake-case application identifier used by generated naming.

domain.title: Application domain
domain.description: The owner's domain. Platform identifiers, linked domains, and a default sending address derive from it. Omission yields a placeholder identifier disclosed as an external prerequisite.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Shared brand values every target honors. Splash screens, launch icons, and navigation-bar branding derive from these rather than being authored.

native.title: Native clients
native.description: Which native clients this Foundation requests. A declined platform drops its project, workflows, and path configuration.

delivery.title: Delivery channels
delivery.description: Which notification channels this Foundation requests. Each carries an external credential the owner must obtain.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Domain record definitions. The collection may be empty while the Plan is being authored. At most one Entity may own Account behavior in this sketch.

development_data.title: Development data
development_data.description: Literal, development-only records that make the generated application useful to explore. Omit when none are needed.

allOf.title: iOS push requires an iOS client
Android push requires an Android client

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Brand values shared by every target. A color accepts a hex string or a light and dark pair.

tint_color.title: Tint color
tint_color.description: The color of interactive elements such as links, buttons, and native tab selection.

background_color.title: Background color
background_color.description: The application background, also used for the generated launch screen and icon field.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Light and dark handling. Omission follows the viewer's system setting.

color.title: Color
color.description: A six-digit hex color, or a light and dark pair when the two differ.

nativeClients.title: Native clients
nativeClients.description: Selected native clients. An omitted platform is not generated; the required outer object may be empty.

deliveryChannels.title: Delivery channels
deliveryChannels.description: Selected notification transports. An omitted channel is not generated; the required outer object may be empty.

ios_push.title: Apple push
ios_push.description: Requires an iOS client and APNs credentials.

android_push.title: Google push
android_push.description: Requires an Android client and Firebase credentials.

web_push.title: Browser push
web_push.description: Requests the profile-pinned browser push implementation.

account.title: Account
account.description: Generated authentication owned by an Entity. Its readable path is the containing Entity key.

identifiers.title: Account identifiers
identifiers.description: Values a person may use to identify the Account during sign in.

sign_in_methods.title: Sign-in methods
sign_in_methods.description: Generated ways to prove control of the Account.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: The generated Account creation flow. Omit when Account creation happens elsewhere.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: The generated ownership-verification flow. Omit when none is used.

recovery.title: Recovery
recovery.description: The generated Account recovery flow. Omit when none is used.

lockout.title: Lockout
lockout.description: Generated protection after repeated failed sign-in attempts. Omit when none is used.

kind.title: Identifier kind
kind.description: Use an email address as the sign-in identifier.

mode.title: Registration mode
mode.description: Allow a visitor to create their own Account.

inputs.title: Registration inputs
inputs.description: Fields and conventional forward Associations collected during registration.

association.title: Association
association.description: An unqualified referencing-side direct Association selected during registration.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether registration can finish without this value.

default.title: Default
default.description: A default used when the input does not ask the registrant for a value.

kind.title: Verification kind
kind.description: Verify control by delivering a link or token to the Account email.

kind.title: Recovery kind
kind.description: Recover the Account by resetting its password.

lockout.title: Lockout
lockout.description: Presence requests the profile-pinned failed-attempt lockout behavior. Omission disables it.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: A domain record type that owns its Fields, relationships, queries, rules, and behavior.

subject_uuid.title: Entity subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Entity.

key.title: Entity key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to the Application.

primary_descriptor.title: Primary descriptor
primary_descriptor.description: The Field, Association, or system Field used to display this record.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: A semantic token naming how this Entity is depicted. Main navigation is its first consumer, and the profile maps it to a platform symbol. Omission takes a neutral fallback.

account.title: Account
account.description: Generated authentication behavior owned by this Entity.

implicit_order_column.title: Implicit order column
implicit_order_column.description: The ascending, deterministic fallback used by ordered finder calls such as first and last. Omit for created_at followed by id.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Stored or target-derived values owned by this Entity.

references.title: References
references.description: Stored relationship facts owned by this Entity.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: Named traversals not mechanically derived from this Entity's References. Every Reference still yields a same-key forward Association in the Compiler graph.

predicates.title: Predicates
predicates.description: Named Boolean classifications of records of this Entity.

orderings.title: Orderings
orderings.description: Reusable, deterministic ordering rules for this Entity.

validations.title: Entity validations
validations.description: Tuple and cross-value rules owned by this Entity. Each rule names its error target.

trees.title: Trees
trees.description: Hierarchies formed by self-References on this Entity.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Authorization rules for operations on this Entity.

scaffold.title: Scaffold
scaffold.description: Selected standard resource routes and reusable behavior. Omit when this Entity requests no Scaffold behavior.

reference_data.title: Reference data
reference_data.description: Small, stable records the application requires in every environment. Omit when the Entity has none.

allOf.title: A profile belongs to the Account-bearing Entity

primaryDescriptor.title: Primary descriptor
primaryDescriptor.description: A typed locator resolved explicitly at each generated interface use.

field.title: Field
field.description: A required Field owned by this Entity. Whole-Plan validation checks requiredness.

association.title: Association
association.description: An unqualified forward Association over a required Reference.

system_field.title: System Field
system_field.description: A target-profile Field generated for every persisted record.

field.title: Field
field.description: A typed value owned by an Entity. Common behavior stays top-level; configuration exists only for types that need it.

fieldDerivation.title: Field derivation
fieldDerivation.description: A typed dependency and value rule for a system-determined Field used by a structured consumer.

associationAggregate.title: Association aggregate
associationAggregate.description: A numeric value calculated from one Field across the current members of an Association.

association.title: Association
association.description: The Association traversed from the Entity that owns the derived Field.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: The aggregate applied to the source Field values.

field.title: Source Field
field.description: The numeric Field read from each associated record.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: A stored relationship fact. Its same-key forward Association is derived automatically.

subject_uuid.title: Reference subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Reference.

key.title: Reference key
key.description: The lower-snake-case stored slot and derived forward Association key local to its Entity.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The complete nonempty set of Entity types this Reference may point to.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether every referencing record needs a target.

one_to_one.title: One to one
one_to_one.description: Whether at most one referencing record may point to each target.

on_referenced_deleted.title: When the referenced record is deleted
on_referenced_deleted.description: The authored consequence when deletion reaches the target record.

oneOf.title: Restrict
oneOf.description: Reject deletion while referencing records remain.

oneOf.title: Nullify the Reference
oneOf.description: Clear this Reference on each surviving referencing record.

oneOf.title: Delete the referencing record
oneOf.description: Delete each record that owns this Reference.

validations.title: Reference validations
validations.description: Conditional rules whose errors belong to this Reference. Omit when none are needed.

default.title: Default
default.description: The initial target selected from a tagged runtime or reference-record value.

immutable.title: Immutable
immutable.description: Whether the target may be chosen at record creation but cannot change afterward.

oneOf.title: Exclusive arc
oneOf.description: Use nullable foreign keys plus an exclusive-arc constraint.

oneOf.title: Polymorphic
oneOf.description: Use a Rails polymorphic association with ID and type columns.

association.title: Association
association.description: A named traversal over one Reference or over other Associations.

subject_uuid.title: Association subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Association.

key.title: Association key
key.description: The lower-snake-case generated reader key local to its Entity.

kind.title: Association kind
kind.description: The explicit discriminator that selects the direct or indirect Association shape.

oneOf.title: Direct
oneOf.description: Traverse one Reference from either its referencing or referenced endpoint.

oneOf.title: Indirect
oneOf.description: Compose a named through Association with a named source Association.

name.title: Association name
name.description: The human-facing label shown to reviewers; it does not determine the generated reader.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The stored Reference traversed by this direct Association.

side.title: Starting side
side.description: Which endpoint owns this direct traversal.

oneOf.title: Referencing
oneOf.description: Start at the Entity that stores the Reference and reach its target.

oneOf.title: Referenced
oneOf.description: Start at one target Entity and reach records that store the Reference.

source.title: Source Association
source.description: The Association followed from each through record.

through.title: Through Association
through.description: The Association followed from the starting Entity.

predicate.title: Predicate
predicate.description: One Predicate owned by the result Entity and applied after the Association traversal.

cardinality.title: Qualified cardinality
cardinality.description: The allowed result count after any Association Predicate is applied.

cardinality.title: Cardinality
cardinality.description: Bounds over distinct result-record identities after any Predicate is applied. Omitted minimum means zero; omitted maximum means unbounded.

predicate.title: Predicate
predicate.description: A named Boolean classification of one Entity's records.

subject_uuid.title: Predicate subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Predicate.

key.title: Predicate key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: The recursive Boolean expression that classifies a record.

implicitOrderColumnSource.title: Implicit order column source
implicitOrderColumnSource.description: One stored, non-null column used in ascending order by ordered finder calls.

ordering.title: Ordering
ordering.description: A named deterministic sequence of sort terms.

subject_uuid.title: Ordering subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Ordering.

key.title: Ordering key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

system_field.title: System Field
system_field.description: A target-provided Field present on every generated record.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: A Tree whose structural ordering should be used.

nulls.title: Null placement
nulls.description: Place records without a value after records with values.

fieldValidation.title: Field validation
fieldValidation.description: A closed rule whose error belongs to the containing Field.

subject_uuid.title: Field validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field validation.

key.title: Field validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Field.

subject_uuid.title: Field validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field validation.

key.title: Field validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Field.

subject_uuid.title: Field validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field validation.

key.title: Field validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Field.

subject_uuid.title: Field validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field validation.

key.title: Field validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Field.

subject_uuid.title: Field validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field validation.

key.title: Field validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Field.

referenceValidation.title: Reference validation
referenceValidation.description: A conditional presence or absence rule whose error belongs to the containing Reference.

subject_uuid.title: Reference validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Reference validation.

key.title: Reference validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Reference.

entityValidation.title: Entity validation
entityValidation.description: A tuple or cross-value rule owned by one Entity.

subject_uuid.title: Entity validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Entity validation.

key.title: Entity validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

nulls.title: Null equality
nulls.description: Whether two tuples with null in the same position remain distinct or conflict.

subject_uuid.title: Entity validation subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Entity validation.

key.title: Entity validation key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

validationErrorTarget.title: Validation error target
validationErrorTarget.description: The Field, Reference, or owning record that receives an Entity Validation error.

subject_uuid.title: State transition subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable State transition.

key.title: State transition key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its State Machine Field.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: Ordered assignments committed and rolled back atomically with this transition.

tree.title: Tree
tree.description: A hierarchy anchored by a parent Reference and optionally partitioned by another Reference.

subject_uuid.title: Tree subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Tree.

key.title: Tree key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

parent_reference.title: Parent Reference
parent_reference.description: The self-Reference that stores each non-root node's parent.

scope_reference.title: Scope Reference
scope_reference.description: A Reference that partitions independent Trees and constrains parent selection.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: One decision; its Policy Expression sources required record and relation projections.

subject_uuid.title: Policy subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Policy.

key.title: Policy key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Exact manage includes standard CRUD; exact destroy supplies a narrower deletion decision.

allow_when.title: Allow when
allow_when.description: The sole allowing Policy Expression. Every projection derives from it; otherwise deny.

referenceData.title: Reference data
referenceData.description: Small, stable records that are part of the application in every environment. This object does not define edit or recompilation policy.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: The owning Entity's Field used to distinguish and reconcile these records.

records.title: Reference records
records.description: Literal records owned by this Entity.

referenceDataRecord.title: Reference data record
referenceDataRecord.description: One stable record. Its owner-local key does not become an application primary key.

subject_uuid.title: Reference data record subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Reference data record.

key.title: Reference data record key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

fields.title: Field values
fields.description: Literal assignments to Fields on the owning Entity. Include the identity Field.

references.title: Reference values
references.description: Assignments from References on the owning Entity to other named data records.

developmentDataRecord.title: Development data record
developmentDataRecord.description: One explicit record in the development-only sample graph. Its owner-local key does not become an application primary key.

subject_uuid.title: Development data record subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Development data record.

key.title: Development data record key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

entity.title: Entity
entity.description: The readable key of the Entity that owns this development record.

fields.title: Field values
fields.description: Literal assignments to Fields on the record's Entity.

references.title: Reference values
references.description: Assignments from References on the record's Entity to named development or reference-data records.

account.title: Development Account data
account.description: Known, non-secret development-only identifiers and credentials for a record of the Account-bearing Entity.

value.title: Target data record
value.description: A tagged pointer to a development or reference-data record.

credentials.title: Account credentials
credentials.description: Known development-only credentials that make the sample account usable.

scaffold.title: Scaffold
scaffold.description: Standard resource route exposure plus directly keyed reusable behavior.

resource_routes.title: Resource routes
resource_routes.description: Selected top-level resource routes. Omit when this Scaffold exposes none.

scaffoldCollection.title: Scaffold index
scaffoldCollection.description: The standard collection page and relation query for one Entity.

scaffoldDetail.title: Scaffold show
scaffoldDetail.description: The standard detail page for one Entity.

scaffoldAssociation.title: Scaffold Association
scaffoldAssociation.description: One recursively projected Association shown from an index item or detail record.

scaffoldProfile.title: Scaffold profile
scaffoldProfile.description: The singular current-Account surface. It edits through this Scaffold's update definition.

iconToken.title: Icon token
iconToken.description: A semantic icon name from a closed vocabulary. The target profile maps each token to an SF Symbol on iOS and a Material icon on Android, so an open string would resolve on one platform and not the other.

scaffoldCreate.title: Scaffold create
scaffoldCreate.description: User inputs, server-owned bindings, authorization, and any top-level new form's return destination.

scaffoldUpdate.title: Scaffold update
scaffoldUpdate.description: User inputs, authorization, and any top-level edit form's return destination.

scaffoldDestroy.title: Scaffold destroy
scaffoldDestroy.description: Authorization and the required return destination for a generated destroy control.

scaffoldAuthorization.title: Scaffold authorization
scaffoldAuthorization.description: Every generated resource request declares public access or a Policy.

oneOf.title: Public
oneOf.description: No Account or Policy decision is required for this generated surface.

authorizationBinding.title: Authorization binding
authorizationBinding.description: Applies a Policy to primary records or items unless record selects a resource gate.

record.title: Policy record
record.description: An explicit runtime gate record. Omit it to authorize the primary record or each collection item.

scaffoldAssociationAuthorization.title: Scaffold Association authorization
scaffoldAssociationAuthorization.description: A displayed Association is public or applies a Policy to each associated record or an explicit gate record.

oneOf.title: Public
oneOf.description: No Account or Policy decision is required for this generated presentation.

scaffoldAssociationAuthorizationBinding.title: Scaffold Association authorization binding
scaffoldAssociationAuthorizationBinding.description: Applies a Policy to each associated record unless record selects a presentation gate.

record.title: Policy record
record.description: An explicit gate record. Omit it to authorize each associated record.

oneOf.title: Scaffold record
oneOf.description: Use the owning record whose index item or detail page contains this Association.

locator.title: Typed locator
locator.description: A typed pointer to a stored Field or Reference.

fieldLocator.title: Field locator
fieldLocator.description: A typed pointer to one Field.

associationLocator.title: Association locator
associationLocator.description: A typed pointer to one Association.

valueLocator.title: Value locator
valueLocator.description: A typed pointer to a Field value or an Association result.

currentRecordTarget.title: Current record target
currentRecordTarget.description: The record in the current Entity scope, including the nested scope of exists.

expressionValuePath.title: Expression value path
expressionValuePath.description: Zero or more singular Association hops followed by one Expression value target.

fieldValuePath.title: Field value path
fieldValuePath.description: Zero or more singular Association hops followed by one Field.

referenceRecordValue.title: Reference-data record value
referenceRecordValue.description: A readable scoped path to one record from an Entity's reference_data collection.

comparisonValue.title: Comparison value
comparisonValue.description: A compatible tagged value or typed target.

comparisonExpression.title: Comparison Expression
comparisonExpression.description: Compare one typed target with a compatible value or nonempty literal set.

isNullExpression.title: Null-test Expression
isNullExpression.description: Test whether one optional queryable scalar Field is null.

matchesPredicateExpression.title: Predicate-reference Expression
matchesPredicateExpression.description: Evaluate another Predicate owned by the current Entity for the current record.

andExpression.title: Conjunction Expression
andExpression.description: True when every child Expression is true.

orExpression.title: Disjunction Expression
orExpression.description: True when at least one child Expression is true.

notExpression.title: Negation Expression
notExpression.description: Negate one child Expression using the same three-valued logic.

existsExpression.title: Existence Expression
existsExpression.description: True when an Association returns a record that satisfies the optional nested Expression.

where.title: Where
where.description: A condition evaluated with each associated record as the current Entity scope.

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: One exact recursive Boolean expression over named data and environment values.

policyAndExpression.title: Policy conjunction Expression
policyAndExpression.description: True when every child Expression is true.

policyOrExpression.title: Policy disjunction Expression
policyOrExpression.description: True when at least one child Expression is true.

policyNotExpression.title: Policy negation Expression
policyNotExpression.description: Negate one child Expression using the same three-valued logic.

policyExistsExpression.title: Policy existence Expression
policyExistsExpression.description: True when an Association returns a record that satisfies the optional nested Expression.

where.title: Where
where.description: A condition evaluated with each associated record as the current Entity scope.

matchesPolicyExpression.title: Policy-reference Expression
matchesPolicyExpression.description: Evaluate a named Policy for the record reached through one singular Association.

policyExpression.title: Policy Expression
policyExpression.description: One recursive allowing condition with Policy-only delegation through a singular Association.

environmentValue.title: Environment value
environmentValue.description: A named value supplied by the target runtime rather than embedded in the Plan.

validationComparisonValue.title: Validation comparison value
validationComparisonValue.description: A compatible tagged value or typed path resolved in the Validation's Entity scope.

validationEnvironmentValue.title: Validation environment value
validationEnvironmentValue.description: A date or time supplied when the generated validation runs.

rubyPattern.title: Ruby regular-expression pattern
rubyPattern.description: A non-executable Regexp body compiled and safety-checked by the pinned Ruby target.

source.title: Source
source.description: Ruby Regexp source without slash delimiters. Use \A and \z for whole-value positive matches. The line anchors ^ and $ are rejected. A positive-position \Z is accepted only for does_not_match so a pattern may include one final newline in its matched set; \Z is rejected inside lookaround or absent expressions and is not a substitute for Field whitespace normalization.

case_insensitive.title: Case insensitive
case_insensitive.description: Compile the pattern with Ruby's ignore-case option.

namedValue.title: Named value
namedValue.description: A stable owner-local semantic value key and its reviewed human-facing name.

subject_uuid.title: Named value subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Named value.

key.title: Named value key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Enum or State Machine Field.

values.title: Enum values
values.description: The complete set of allowed semantic values in stable order.

ordinal.title: Ordinal enum
ordinal.description: Whether value order carries semantic rank rather than presentation order alone.

counts.title: Counted Association
counts.description: The Association whose distinct members determine this count.

within.title: Position scope
within.description: Fields and References that partition records into ordered lists. [] means one global list.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: An uppercase three-letter currency code supported by the selected target profile.

initial_state.title: Initial state
initial_state.description: The state persisted when a new record is created.

states.title: States
states.description: The complete closed set of states stored by this Field.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.description: The events that move this Field between its states.

when.title: Available when
when.description: A condition under which this optional State Machine Field applies.

subject_uuid.title: Field subject UUID
subject_uuid.description: Stable Project-scoped identity for this independently mutable Field.

key.title: Field key
key.description: The lower-snake-case readable key local to its Entity.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Optional explanatory prose for people reviewing the Field. It does not request behavior.

type.title: Field type
type.description: The semantic value kind. One Field may unfold into several target implementation elements.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether a stored record may omit this value.

validations.title: Field validations
validations.description: Additional rules whose errors belong to this Field. Omit when none are needed.

default.title: Default
default.description: A semantic initial value that the Compiler must realize explicitly.

derivation.title: Derivation
derivation.description: A typed rule that continuously and exclusively determines this Field's current value.

immutable.title: Immutable
immutable.description: Whether the value may be assigned at record creation but cannot change afterward.

comparison.title: Comparison
comparison.description: The semantic comparison behavior required for this Field.

normalizations.title: Normalizations
normalizations.description: Ordered cleanup. Null stays null. Omit when unused; collapse_whitespace includes trim.

oneOf.title: Trim
oneOf.description: Remove leading and trailing Unicode whitespace.

oneOf.title: Blank to null
oneOf.description: Replace an empty or Unicode-whitespace-only string with null.

oneOf.title: Collapse whitespace
oneOf.description: Trim Unicode whitespace and replace each internal whitespace run with U+0020.

oneOf.title: Downcase
oneOf.description: Replace the text using the target profile's documented Unicode lowercase mapping.

encrypted_at_rest.title: Encrypted at rest
encrypted_at_rest.description: Whether generated storage must encrypt the value at rest.

redact_from_logs.title: Redact from logs
redact_from_logs.description: Whether generated diagnostics and logs must redact the value.

literalValue.title: Literal value
literalValue.description: A literal JSON value. Decimal and money semantics use a canonical decimal string.

path.title: Typed path
path.description: Zero or more singular Association hops followed by one typed terminal target.

environmentPathValue.title: Environment path value
environmentPathValue.description: A typed value reached from the current Account through singular Associations.

value.title: Value
value.description: A closed, tagged value whose object literals cannot be confused with runtime instructions.

comparisonClause.title: Comparison clause
comparisonClause.description: One semantic comparison operator and its compatible right operand.

transitionEffect.title: Transition effect
transitionEffect.description: One ordered assignment performed atomically with a successful state transition.

scaffoldProjection.title: Scaffold projection
scaffoldProjection.description: An ordered, finite selection of Fields and recursively presented Associations.

scaffoldInput.title: Scaffold input
scaffoldInput.description: One user-selected Field or forward Association.

scaffoldBinding.title: Server-owned create binding
scaffoldBinding.description: A Field or Reference assigned by generated request code before authorization and persistence.

returnToRecord.title: Return-to record
returnToRecord.description: Resolves a resource record from the mutation or the Scaffold record that rendered an inline form.

through.title: Association path
through.description: An optional path of singular, guaranteed-present Association hops. Repeating a self-Association is valid.

returnTo.title: Return to
returnTo.description: The one required destination carried by a generated HTML mutation interaction. It is never a fallback.

oneOf.title: Current location
oneOf.description: Return to the same validated internal location that rendered this interaction.

scaffoldMutationReturnTo.title: Top-level Scaffold mutation return to
scaffoldMutationReturnTo.description: A top-level create, update, destroy, or profile interaction can resolve a show record only from the mutation record. scaffold_record exists only for an associated create form.

scaffoldDestroyReturnTo.title: Scaffold destroy return to
scaffoldDestroyReturnTo.description: A destroy interaction cannot return to the deleted mutation record's own show route. A show destination must traverse to another record.

scaffoldCreateForm.title: Associated create form
scaffoldCreateForm.description: A form that posts to the associated Entity's top-level create route and supplies the inverse Reference through the parent context.
